style: Simple friendly flat vector illustration for a language-learning app. Soft pastel colours, plain light cream background, clear single subject, thick clean shapes. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or writing anywhere.

pictures.name: ch10-on
pictures.scene: A cat sitting clearly on top of a closed cardboard box, the whole box visible.
pictures.alt: A cat sitting on top of a box.
pictures.translation: The cat is on the box.

pictures.name: ch10-under
pictures.scene: A cat sitting clearly underneath a simple wooden table, the whole table visible with the cat on the floor below its top.
pictures.sentence: 猫はテーブルの{}にいます。
pictures.translation: The cat is under the table.

pictures.name: ch10-in
pictures.scene: A cat inside an open cardboard box, only its head and paws showing above the rim.
pictures.alt: A cat inside an open box.
pictures.translation: The cat is in the box.

pictures.name: ch10-front
pictures.scene: A dog sitting clearly in front of a small house, close to the viewer, with the house behind it.
pictures.alt: A dog in front of a house.
pictures.translation: The dog is in front of the house.

pictures.name: ch10-behind
pictures.scene: A dog peeking out from behind a single tree trunk, most of the dog hidden by the trunk, only its head visible at the side.
pictures.alt: A dog looking out from behind a tree.
pictures.translation: The dog is behind the tree.

pictures.name: ch10-next
pictures.scene: A cat and a dog sitting side by side next to each other, facing the viewer, on the same ground line.
pictures.alt: A cat sitting next to a dog.
pictures.translation: The cat is next to the dog.

pictures.name: ch20-hat
pictures.scene: A smiling young person from the chest up wearing a bright red hat. Plain t-shirt. No glasses, no coat.
pictures.sentence: この人は帽子を{}います。
pictures.translation: This person is wearing a hat.

pictures.name: ch20-glasses
pictures.scene: A smiling young person from the chest up wearing round black glasses. Plain t-shirt. No hat, no coat.
pictures.sentence: この人は眼鏡を{}います。

pictures.name: ch20-shoes
pictures.scene: A full-body young person standing, wearing bright red sneakers that stand out, with plain grey clothes in neutral colours. No hat, no glasses, no coat.

pictures.name: ch20-coat
pictures.scene: A full-body young person standing and wearing a long buttoned-up green winter coat. No hat, no glasses.
pictures.sentence: この人はコートを{}います。
pictures.translation: This person is wearing a coat.
